sourceBindings.text: The teacher example mentions roughly 400–500°C for several hours, but that range alone is not a complete standard operating procedure. A laboratory must define its sample preparation, vessel, drying and ignition schedule, cooling, blanks or quality checks and safety controls before a real test. Methods at other temperatures and times are not automatically interchangeable.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
